mapper.select: SELECT l.ledger_id, l.emp_id, l.att_month, l.month_work_days, l.att_days, l.leave_days, l.overtime_days, l.absent_days, l.ledger_status, l.create_time, l.update_time, COALESCE(e.emp_code, '') AS emp_code, COALESCE(e.emp_name, '') AS emp_name, e.dept_id AS dept_id, COALESCE(d.dept_name, '') AS dept_name FROM hr_att_ledger l LEFT JOIN sys_emp e ON l.emp_id = e.emp_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE l.ledger_id = #{ledgerId}

SELECT l.ledger_id, l.emp_id, l.att_month, l.month_work_days, l.att_days, l.leave_days, l.overtime_days, l.absent_days, l.ledger_status, l.create_time, l.update_time, COALESCE(e.emp_code, '') AS emp_code, COALESCE(e.emp_name, '') AS emp_name, e.dept_id AS dept_id, COALESCE(d.dept_name, '') AS dept_name FROM hr_att_ledger l LEFT JOIN sys_emp e ON l.emp_id = e.emp_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE l.emp_id = #{empId} AND l.att_month = #{attMonth}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hr_att_ledger (emp_id, att_month, month_work_days, att_days, leave_days, overtime_days, absent_days, ledger_status) VALUES (#{empId}, #{attMonth}, #{monthWorkDays}, #{attDays}, #{leaveDays}, #{overtimeDays}, #{absentDays}, #{ledgerStatus})
